numerology_page.title: Numerology
numerology_page.input_subtitle: Your name and birth date hold a sacred code
numerology_page.input_hint: Enter your full name and birth date to reveal the numbers shaping your path.
numerology_page.section_life_path_intro: The path your soul walks in this lifetime
numerology_page.section_birthday_intro: The gift you carry from the day of your arrival
numerology_page.footer_note: Numbers are derived through Pythagorean numerology. Master numbers (11, 22, 33) carry amplified vibration and stay unreduced.
numerology_page.desc_1: Born to lead, you carry the courage to begin where others hesitate. Independence and bold initiative shape your path — trust your inner fire and stand in your originality.
numerology_page.desc_2: Your gift is harmony. Sensitive to undercurrents, you build bridges where others see walls. Partnership, intuition and quiet strength guide your steps.
numerology_page.desc_3: Joy and creative expression flow through you. Your words and presence uplift others — embrace play, share your art, and let your authentic voice be heard.
numerology_page.desc_4: Discipline and devotion are your foundation. You turn vision into structure, brick by patient brick. Stability and integrity are your sacred tools.
numerology_page.desc_5: Freedom calls you forward. Curiosity, change and bold experience shape your journey — trust the road less traveled and let new winds awaken you.
numerology_page.desc_6: Love is your medicine. You hold others with grace, nurturing home, family and community. Remember to receive the care you so freely give.
numerology_page.desc_7: You are tuned to the unseen. Solitude, study and inner reflection unlock the wisdom you came here to share. Trust the quiet voice within.
numerology_page.desc_8: Power, mastery and abundance are your birthright. With clear intent you can build legacies that uplift many. Lead from integrity, never from ego.
numerology_page.desc_9: Old soul of completion. Compassion, vision and selfless service shape your purpose — you came to lift the world and release what no longer serves.
numerology_page.desc_11: A spiritual messenger. Heightened intuition and inspiration flow through you — honor your sensitivity and let your light illuminate the path for others.
numerology_page.desc_22: You came to manifest the seemingly impossible. Bold vision meets disciplined craft; what you build can become legacy that serves generations.
numerology_page.desc_33: The path of unconditional love. Healing, service and spiritual teaching flow through you — ground yourself, then offer your medicine to the world.
numerology_page.full_name_hint: As written on your birth certificate
numerology_page.section_destiny_intro: How you express your talents and reach your life purpose
numerology_page.section_soul_urge_intro: Your deepest inner motivation — what your soul truly craves
numerology_page.section_personality_intro: The face you show the world — others' first impression of you
numerology_page.section_maturity_intro: The energy awakening after 35–40 — your second spring and ultimate destination
numerology_page.info_lp_what: The most important number. Like your Sun sign in astrology — it reveals your core purpose, the route your soul walks, and the talents you were born with.
numerology_page.info_lp_how: Each component of your birth date is first reduced separately (day → single digit, month → single digit, year → single digit), then all three are summed and reduced again. Master numbers 11, 22, 33 are never reduced.
numerology_page.info_bd_what: A specific talent or tool you carry from the day you arrived. A focused gift that supports your Life Path.
numerology_page.info_bd_how: Only the digits of your birth day are summed. Example: born on the 29th → 2 + 9 = 11 (master number, kept as-is).
numerology_page.info_dst_what: How you express your talents to the outside world, your career potential, and how you will reach your life goals.
numerology_page.info_dst_how: Every letter in your full birth name is converted to a number using the Pythagorean table (A=1, B=2 … I=9, J=1 …), then all values are summed and reduced.
numerology_page.info_su_what: Your deepest inner motivations, hidden passions, and what your soul truly craves in love and life.
numerology_page.info_su_how: Only the vowels (A, E, I, O, U) in your full name are converted and summed using the Pythagorean table.
numerology_page.info_per_what: How others perceive you — the first impression you make, like the Rising sign in astrology.
numerology_page.info_per_how: Only the consonants in your full name are converted and summed using the Pythagorean table.
numerology_page.info_mat_what: The second-spring energy that awakens around ages 35–40, revealing where you are ultimately heading and who you are becoming.
numerology_page.info_mat_how: Life Path Number + Destiny Number, then reduced to a single digit (master numbers preserved).
